about: A whole page to read about a place, Hampi, written from the Wikipedia article looked up and two pages read: a timeline, facts, bullets, a stat, a diagram of the sites, directions there, the article as the reference (credited once), and maths-free prose with prices.

reference.title: Hampi
reference.extract: Hampi or Hampe, also referred to as the Group of Monuments at Hampi, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site located in Hampi town, Vijayanagara district, east-central Karnataka, India.

wire.subject: places
wire.title: Hampi
wire.summary: Hampi is the ruined capital of the Vijayanagara Empire, a UNESCO site in Karnataka.

nodes.label: Virupaksha Temple
nodes.detail: Still in worship since the 7th century.

nodes.label: Vittala Temple
nodes.detail: Its stone chariot is on the ₹50 note.

blocks.text: Hampi was one of the largest cities in the world around 1500. Entry to the Vittala Temple costs $5 to $10 for visitors from abroad.

items.value: The city is sacked after the Battle of Talikota.
